name: Murf
verdict: A pay-as-you-go voice API with a published per-character rate, not a flat creator plan on the page we opened.
pros: API trial does not need a card
Purchased API credit does not expire
cons: No studio subscription price on the page we opened
Harder to compare with a flat monthly creator plan
pricingNote: On 2026-10-14, murf.ai/pricing showed the API rates above and a free trial with $10 of API credit. A creator or studio subscription price was not on that page.
